claim_text: Aligned DINOv2 ViT-B improves aggregate Spearman correlation with human THINGS-triplet similarity judgments compared to unaligned DINOv2 ViT-B (delta_rho >= 0.05).
swap_description: Student changed from DINOv2 ViT-B (768-dim, 86M params) to DINOv2 ViT-S (384-dim, 21M params). Teacher (SigLIP-So400m) and all hyperparameters unchanged.
reasoning: C2a claims delta_rho >= 0.05 (aligned vs unaligned Spearman). With DINOv2 ViT-S student: aligned=0.5397, unaligned=0.2157, delta_rho=+0.324 — 6.5x the required threshold. Direction and magnitude are both consistent with the main experiment (ViT-B delta_rho=+0.366). The alignment improvement is robust to student model size change (86M -> 21M params, 768-dim -> 384-dim). Verdict: supported, consistent_with_main_experiment=pass.
